verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting or opt-out that controls whether conversations are used for model training. Business workspaces are described as having 'enterprise-grade privacy protections' and conversations 'protected under business plan terms', but neither statement mentions training data use. That makes them an adjacent privacy feature, not a training control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
